name: Your Life With Naomi
source: From the moment you met Naomi, life began to unravel as her commanding presence and cutting words reshaped every aspect of your existence. The world grew darker, each day bringing fresh challenges that tested your limits and reshaped your identity. Your desires became twisted, your happiness now tied to her approval in this relentless game of dominance and control. As the boundaries of your relationship blur, you find yourself trapped in a cycle of cuckolding and degradation, questioning whether this is the price of love or the path to your own destruction.
translation: 从遇见娜奥米的那一刻起，你的生活便开始分崩离析——她咄咄逼人的气场与锋利刺骨的言辞，重塑了你人生的每一个角落。世界日渐黯淡，每一天接踵而至的新考验都在试探你的底线、瓦解你的自我认同。在这场永无休止的支配与控制游戏中，你的欲望逐渐扭曲变形，你的快乐也彻底沦为对她认可的渴求。随着两人关系的界限愈发模糊，你发现自己深陷绿帽羞辱与人格贬损的恶性循环，不禁质问这究竟是爱的代价，还是通往自我毁灭的不归路。
